outcomes: NOTES ON STANDARDS ALIGNMENT:In this module, students work with a variety of fractional units. These fractional units include halves, thirds, fourths, sixths, and eighths, which are specified in the Grade 3 standards, as well as additional fractional units such as fifths, ninths, tenths, and twelfths. These additional fractional units are not part of the Grade 3 standards. Their inclusion in this module combats rigid thinking, encouraging students to see any number as a fractional unit. This bridges to content in Grades 4 and 5 (4.NF.1-7 and 5.NF.1-7). Module 5 assessments do not test the additional fractions.
